2609.04912.title: TreeFI: Value-Aware Statistical Fault Injection for Deep Neural Networks
2609.04912.paper_summary: Reliability evaluation of deep neural networks under hardware faults commonly relies on fault injection, but exhaustive campaigns are intractable for modern models and datasets. Statistical fault injection reduces this cost, yet existing approaches still require large injection budgets because they do not explicitly exploit a key property of floating-point faults: the effect of a bit flip depends strongly on the value being corrupted. We propose TreeFI, a value-aware statistical fault-injection methodology for FP32 single-bit faults in DNN activations and weights. TreeFI partitions each layer's value distribution into intervals with similar expected bit-flip behavior, learned using regression trees, and allocates injections across these intervals according to their relevance for failure-rate estimation. This stratified allocation preserves the target confidence and error margin while avoiding unnecessary injections in low-impact regions of the fault space. We validate TreeFI on CNN and Transformer models using CIFAR-10 and ImageNet. On ResNet8, where exhaustive activation fault injection is feasible, TreeFI provides more accurate estimates than state-of-the-art statistical FI baselines under the same campaign setting. Across the evaluated models, TreeFI reduces the required injection budget by up to 72.1x, with average reductions of 44.9x for activation faults and 11.2x for the executed weight campaigns.
2609.04912.paper_summary_zh: 深度神經網絡在硬體故障下的可靠性評估通常依賴於故障注入，但對於現代模型和數據集而言，全面的測試活動是不可行的。統計故障注入減少了這一成本，然而現有的方法仍然需要大量的注入預算，因為它們並未明確利用浮點故障的一個關鍵特性：位元翻轉的影響強烈依賴於被破壞的值。我們提出了 TreeFI，一種針對 DNN 激活和權重中的 FP32 單位故障的值感知統計故障注入方法。TreeFI 將每一層的值分佈劃分為具有相似預期位元翻轉行為的區間，這些區間是通過回歸樹學習得出的，並根據其對故障率估計的相關性在這些區間中分配注入。這種分層分配保留了目標信心和誤差範圍，同時避免在故障空間的低影響區域進行不必要的注入。我們在使用 CIFAR-10 和 ImageNet 的 CNN 和 Transformer 模型上驗證了 TreeFI。在 ResNet8 上，全面的激活故障注入是可行的，TreeFI 在相同的測試設置下提供了比最先進的統計 FI 基準更準確的估計。在評估的模型中，TreeFI 將所需的注入預算減少了最多 72.1 倍，激活故障的平均減少為 44.9 倍，執行權重測試的平均減少為 11.2 倍。
